api:
OV.BattleUI.model gains confirmEarly(pointerType, detail, dtMs) → bool. It is true when a 2nd click must not confirm an explosive: the click is the 2nd of a double-click (detail > 1) or arrives less than 400 ms after the confirmation was armed. Keyboard ('kb') is never early.

OV.BattleUI.model.kbStep(m, x, y, dir, anchor) has the same signature; the anchor now also carries `last` (the previous arrow). When the axis changes, a tie picks the neighbour that continues the previous arrow, so ↓←↓← walks one grid row.

OV.BattleUI.model.logEntry(B, {t:'zombify', unitId, fromId}) now names the soldier from fromId (feminine variant via gk); `at` is the zombie's tile.

OV.InventoryUI.model gains loadPlan(loadout) → {R, L}: {slot, k, type} | null. It returns the clip that OV.BUnits.autoLoad will put into each weapon: right hand, then left hand; first compatible clip in the belt, then the pack.

OV.Input click events gain `detail` (1, or 2 for the 2nd click of a double-click).

OV.BattleRender view.path gains `subCol` (a palette name) for the 2nd label.

The battle sets the CSS variable --bs-bot on <body>: the measured height of the bottom HUD, removed on exit.

New pt-PT keys: hud.door.hint.far(.mac/.key), hud.path.reserve, hud.path.reserve.kneel, hud.path.reserve.fix(.touch), hud.path.reserve.deny(.touch), hud.stop.reserved(.touch), hud.hint.aim.touch, hud.tip.squad.touch, hud.tip.alienKeys.touch, hud.tip.night.touch, hud.equip.inWeapon(.tip), hud.equip.load, hud.equip.spare, hud.equip.noAmmo.tip. Changed: hud.keys.9, hud.equip.hint(.touch), hud.equip.auto.tip.

Equip-screen behaviour:
- The hand weapon shows the "28/28" or "Vazia" badge.
- The clip that goes into the weapon is marked «Na arma».
- Ammo from stores dropped on a hand weapon goes to the belt or pack, with the label «Carregar» or «Reserva».
- ⌫ returns the picked item (picked by mouse or touch) to stores.
- Tapping or clicking an item inside a container that accepts the picked item drops it into that container.
- Enter on a cell that refuses the item denies with sound and text and keeps the selection.
- After a redraw, focus returns to the same item or compartment.
- ↑/↓ take the nearest row inside the same zone.
summary:
Battle/inventory fixer, persona round 2: 21 of 23 findings fixed in my files; 1 skipped as another fixer's file (#13) and 1 fixed only in part (#21). Exact patches for the rest are in open_issues.
- `node tools/test.js --strict --i18n`: 677/677 green. The only missing key is the suite's own test key `nao.existe.x`.
- New `qa/persona_r2_battle.mjs`: 0 failures, one check per finding at 1440×900, 1194×834, 1024×576 (125 %) and iPad 834×1194 / 1194×834 with touch.
- Also green: `persona_r1_battle`, `inventory_check`, `ux_regress`, `battle_play` and `full_campaign` (full campaign ran once without errors).
- `full_battle`: both battles won, but its "granadas lançadas: 0" check failed again, as in round 1. The bot cancelled each throw for no trajectory, a roof overhead or too few TU, so it never clicked to throw. Not caused by these changes.
- I looked at the screenshots of every changed screen; they are in `scratchpad/ui4/persona_r2/` and `scratchpad/ui4/r2/`.

Per finding:
- **#0 Equip shows an empty weapon and 2 belt clips — fixed.** The new `loadPlan` copies `BUnits.autoLoad`. The hand now shows «28/28» (or «Vazia») and the clip that goes into the weapon is marked «NA ARMA». Help texts now say "carregada e com um carregador de reserva". A Node test checks the result against `fromSoldier` + `autoLoad`.
- **#1 and #8 Door hint promises "0 UT" — fixed.** Far from the door the hint reads «⌥ + clique abre a porta quando o soldado estiver ao lado dela», with no cost. Next to it, the real cost is shown (4 UT). Touch never shows the ⌥ hint.
- **#2 and #19 Equip header: buttons cover weight and warning — fixed at the root.** The meters had min-width:auto and overflowed their column. They are now pinned (min-width:0) and the warning wraps to two lines. The header layout now follows the doll's width (new container `eqd`): the buttons move to their own row below 640 px. Checked at 1440, 1194, 1024×576 and 834.
- **#3 ⌫ ignores an item picked with the mouse — fixed.**
- **#4 and #22 Toasts and the turn report overlap — fixed.**
  - While the report is open, toasts move to just above the measured bottom HUD (`--bs-bot`).
  - In portrait the report sits right of the squad list (left 170 px, right 70 px).
- **#5 Double-click fires a risky Blaster shot or grenade — fixed.** `OV.Input` now sends `detail`. A click that is the 2nd of a double-click, or comes less than 400 ms after the warning appeared, does not confirm. QA: a double-click does not fire; a separate click afterwards does.
- **#6 «Zombie transformou-se num zombie!» — fixed.** The presenter toast and the log now use `fromId`, so it reads «Palesa Steyn transformou-se num zombie!».
- **#7 Ammo dropped on a weapon is not loaded — fixed** in the Equip screen («Carregar»). The briefing line "N soldados levam armas sem munição" is not done (open_issues).
- **#9 T ignores the mouse pointer — fixed.** Without a keyboard cursor, T turns the soldier to the tile under the pointer. The key sheet line mentions this and the secondary click.
- **#10 ↓←↓← stalls between two tiles — fixed.** When the arrow changes axis, the step follows the previous arrow. ↓←×3 now moves y+6. Node and browser tests.
- **#11 Report buttons unreachable by keyboard — fixed.** When opened from the keyboard, focus goes to «Fechar». Tab / ⇧Tab cycle the report's buttons instead of changing soldier. Enter or Space activate «Mostrar». Esc closes and returns focus to the game.
- **#12 Path into the TU reserve looks like a normal move — fixed.** The engine walks partway and stops before eating the reserve, so the label now says «Custa 30 UT · ficam 20 — o soldado para antes, para guardar 22 UT (Tiro rápido)». A second label tells how to go all the way (F1, or «Sem reserva» on touch), in reserve colour. The stop toast explains why, and the rare case where the first step is refused gets the same detail.
- **#13 Focus drops to BODY in the base — skipped.** The file is `base_ui.js`, which I don't own; the patch is in open_issues.
- **#14 Keyboard jumps in Equip and Inventory — fixed.**
  - After dropping an item, focus stays on it (never «Copiar»).
  - ↓ from the right hand goes to the belt.
  - ←/→ only move within a cone, not to a tile far above or below.
  - Enter on an occupied cell refuses and keeps the selection.
- **#15 Two identical «Canhão Pesado: m…» lines on the ground — fixed.** Ground names now wrap to two lines.
- **#16 Key sheet opens scrolled to the bottom — fixed.** The footer is sticky and the list opens at the top.
- **#17 Briefing Equip at 1024×560 — overlap fixed.** The doll now scrolls instead of passing over the info card. The footer text belongs to `campaign.js` (open_issues).
- **#18 Tapping a store row with an item picked selects that row — fixed.** If the row's container accepts the picked item, the tap stores it.
- **#20 Portrait aim hint hidden behind the action panel — fixed.** The hint sits above the measured `--bs-bot`.
- **#21 Keyboard/mouse-only texts on iPad — fixed in part.**
  - Fixed in my files: tapping an alien now says to tap the weapon; the squad, alien and night tooltips have touch variants; key emblems (including the Q/E hand letters) are hidden on hover:none.
  - Not fixed (other fixers' files, patches in open_issues): briefing, options, defeat tip and menu texts.
deviations: #12: the finding assumed the move is refused. The engine actually walks partway and stops before eating the reserve (validate returns ok; a 'reserved' interrupt fires mid-walk). So the label explains the early stop and how to go all the way, instead of saying the move is impossible. The presenter's interrupt toast for 'reserved' now says the same.

#0: I did not change autoLoadout to 1 loaded + 2 spare clips. The starting craft carries only 2 clips per rifle (base.js cargo rifle 6 / rifle_clip 12), so 3 per soldier would leave some soldiers without clips. Instead the screen now shows the truth: the weapon loaded, the clip marked «Na arma», and the help says «carregada e com um carregador de reserva».

#18/#14: the picker change also applies to the battle inventory. A click or Enter on an item now drops the held item into that item's container when the container accepts it; otherwise a click still switches the selection. Enter on a container that refuses denies with a reason instead of silently switching.

qa/persona_r1_battle.mjs: the keyboard walk heuristic in the round-1 Equip check now presses ← before ↑ when stuck. The stricter ←/→ cone of the new navigation changed the route; the behaviour checked is the same.
open_issues: #13 (base_ui.js, not mine). In setTab(), after renderContent(): `if (!quiet || document.activeElement === document.body) { const t = r.tabs.querySelector('.bsc-tab.on'); if (t) t.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }`. In closeEquip(), after refresh() inside `if (!silent)`: `OV.Dom.refocus('[data-act="equip"][data-craft="' + E.craftId + '"]', S.root) || OV.Dom.refocus('[data-act="equip"]', S.root);` (use the equip button's real data attribute). For a dialog opened by shortcut (N → research), pass `returnTo: S.root.querySelector('[data-act=newResearch]')` to OV.Dom.trapFocus.

#17 (pt-PT.campaign.js, not mine): 'cp.eq.hint': 'Arraste ou clique num objeto e depois no destino · setas e Enter movem objetos · ⌫ devolve ao armazém · Tab ou 1–9 muda de soldado · Esc conclui'. The overlap part is fixed in battle.css.

#7 briefing warning (campaign_ui.js / screens.js, not mine): the line «N soldados levam armas sem munição» with an «Equipar automaticamente» button can use OV.InventoryUI.model.loadPlan(lo). An armed hand has a firearm with ammo and loadPlan(lo)[h] === null means it starts empty. Text key e.g. 'cp.br.note.noAmmo.one/other': '{n} soldado(s) leva(m) armas sem munição'.

#21 rest (other fixers' files): add '.touch' variants chosen with OV.Input.lastPointerType === 'touch'. pt-PT.campaign.js 'cp.br.note.waitDay.touch': 'Sugestão: o botão «Esperar pelo dia» deixa a nave no local e volta a perguntar ao amanhecer — de dia os soldados veem tão longe como os alienígenas.' pt-PT.screens.js 'scr.db.tip.enemy.touch': '… ajoelhe-se (botão do soldado ajoelhado) no fim do movimento …'; 'scr.opt.speed.hint.touch': 'Durante a animação, um toque acelera ×8.'; 'scr.opt.instantGrenades.hint.touch': 'Ativar e lançar com espoleta a zero numa só ação (botão da granada).'; 'scr.menu.howto.hint.touch': 'Controlos e regras essenciais'. css/base.css: `@media (hover: none) { .btn .key, .modal .key { display: none; } }` (the battle side and battle modals are already hidden in battle.css).

Quick Battle loadoutFor (screens.js) still gives the weapon + 2 belt clips. With autoLoad that means loaded + 1 spare, which the Equip screen now shows honestly («Na arma»). If fixer B wants 2 spares there, add a third clip where Strength allows.

qa/full_battle.mjs: «granadas lançadas: 0» failed again, as in round 1. The bot's throw targets in seeds dia/noite are refused for no arc, a roof or too few TU, so it never clicks to throw. A target-selection improvement in the bot would make this check meaningful.
